description.en: Nachum of Gamzo was a pious scholar who lived during the time of R. Yochanan b. Zakkai and was one of R. Akiva's teachers. He is most famous for his faith in God, regardless of obstacles in his path. He is therefore associated with the phrase he used for these obstacles, gam zo letova (this too is for the good).
description.he: נחום איש גמזו היה תנא וצדיק שחי בתקופת רבן יוחנן בן זכאי ומרבותיו של רבי עקיבא. נודע בעיקר באמונתו הגדולה חרף המכשולים שעמדו בדרכו. על כן התפרסם בביטוי "גם זו לטובה".

en.title: The Miraculous Protection of Nachum of Gamzo
en.ai_title: The Miraculous Protection of Nachum of Gamzo
en.prompt: The miraculous protection associated with Nachum of Gamzo's presence is a testament to his extraordinary spiritual power. The Talmud recounts how a dilapidated house remained standing solely due to Nachum of Gamzo's presence, collapsing only after he was removed.

en.title: Finding Joy in Adversity
en.prompt: Rejoicing in one's troubles can lead to recognizing that apparent evils may ultimately result in good outcomes. The 15th-century ethical work, Orchot Tzadikim, emphasizes maintaining a positive attitude and faith in God's plan, even during difficult times.

en.ai_title: The Origin of Rabbi Nachum's Name
en.prompt: Rabbi Nachum of Gimso's name and his famous phrase 'All is for the best' reflect his unwavering faith and optimism. This biography delves into the life and teachings of Rabbi Nachum, a Tanna known for his profound trust in divine providence.
